title: Find the git commit that added or removed a piece of text
summary: Searches the history of a git project for the commits where the number of times a text appears changed, which is usually the commit that added it or removed it. You get a list of commits without reading every one.

aliases.text: git find which commit added a string
find commit that introduced text in git

steps.explain: Find the commits where the number of occurrences of the text changed. --all searches every branch. Quote the text so that spaces and symbols are kept.
steps.expect: One line per commit: a short commit id, then the commit message.

alternatives.explain: Use a pattern instead of plain text. -G finds every commit that changed a line matching the pattern, including edits that keep the count the same.

steps.explain: Show what one commit changed. Pick the commit id from the list in the previous step.
steps.expect: The commit message, then the lines added (+) and removed (-) in that commit.
